blurb: Guests can visit two brewpubs in Santa Rosa and Windsor, open 7 days a week except major holidays and an annual company picnic. The Windsor location offers guided tours Friday through Sunday with beer tastings and a souvenir glass, plus a free self-guided tour daily. Both locations have dog-friendly outdoor seating and host events including private bookings.
extraNote: Pubs closed on Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day, and annual Summer employee family picnic · Reservations accepted for larger parties by phone; smaller parties first come, first served
